data.one_liner: Tactile text roll animation for tiny labels, counters, and status text.
data.what_it_does: Provides a text roll animation where changed glyphs slide vertically, with optional color flashes and support for rich text, sequences, and editable text corrections.
use_when: Command feedback like Copy to Copied
avoid_when: Complex layout transitions not involving text rolls
strengths: Dependency-light with no runtime dependencies beyond Flutter
Handles emoji clusters and Arabic shaping correctly
Respects platform reduced motion accessibility settings
weaknesses: Focused primarily on short, high-signal text
Latin kerning and ligatures can differ slightly from standard Text runs during animation

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: For general-purpose widget animations and timelines rather than specialized slot-based text rolling.
